steps.text: Run platform integration verify at repo root to validate packages and dependencies:
steps.code:
pnpm run verify
npm run verify

steps.text: BDS crashes or fails to bind UDP 19132 → check for orphaned bedrock_server processes and terminate them.
db-server fails with EADDRINUSE:3001 → update db_port in configs/db_config.json or set DB_PORT environment variable.
LLBot reports port 3002 conflict → ensure no duplicate qq-bridge instances or competing reverse WS clients.
Inspect listening ports (Windows / Linux):
Instant exit or node:sqlite error → upgrade Node.js to 22.13+ (requires native node:sqlite support)
Port in use → change db_port in configs/db_config.json or set DB_PORT env
Module API issues → verify modulesDir and SFMC_ROOT paths
SQLite corruption → stop services and restore database from data/backups
Check daemon health:
Module HTTP requests return 401 Unauthorized → verify SAPI successfully fetched GET /api/sfmc/configs/all and cached the module_token.
Manual curl requests fail with 401 → ensure Authorization: Bearer <token> header is included.
Admin token mismatch → check http_auth in configs/db_config.json or HTTP_AUTH env.
Check load summary and log files under <SFMC_ROOT>/.sfmc/logs/
Run sfmc> mod build to ensure esbuild pack bundling finishes without syntax or missing dependency errors.
Confirm inbox conflicts are not blocking pre-start scan (see Add-ons guide):

nodes.title: Module enabled but no effect in-game

steps.text: Did you run mod reload or restart BDS? (Code changes require reload; config changes require BDS restart)
Is enabled: true present in modules/module-lock.json?
Inspect GET /api/sfmc/modules/<id> to confirm live module state
If entities/world APIs fail during startup → verify if registration should specify afterWorldLoad: true
Ensure all dependency modules defined in manifest.json are installed and enabled
[Official] Verify qq_app_id and qq_app_secret; ensure server public IP is added to the QQ Open Platform allowlist.
[Official] Ensure GROUP_AT_MESSAGE_CREATE is subscribed; group messages must @ the bot to trigger.
[Official] Ensure qq_group_openid has been copied from startup logs into configs/qq_config.json.
[LLBot] Verify reverse WS is ws://127.0.0.1:3002 and firewall allows the port.
Build monorepo first, then pack modules:
steps.code:
pnpm run build
npm run build --workspaces --if-present
sfmc> mod build

steps.text: Legacy modules importing "@sfmc/sdk" → reinstall using the latest CLI, or verify SDK package resolution
